name: guarded-notes-mcp
description: Local-only Apple Notes organizer with safety-gated moves, snapshots, audit logs, and rollback planning.

interface.shortDescription: Safely inspect and organize Apple Notes on your Mac.
interface.longDescription: A dependency-free, local-only organizer for Apple Notes. It inventories notes, reuses unchanged cached content, creates safety snapshots, and previews exact folder changes. Every move requires an expiring plan, exact confirmation, and a separate one-use Terminal authorization. It cannot delete notes or edit note content.
defaultPrompt: Review my Apple Notes and propose an organization plan.
Create a safety-backed preview of these note moves.
Show the exact notes and folders in this move batch.
